pr_title: sql: setup http router after version initialization
pr_body:
Previously the http routes were set up after sql version initialization. As of #127170, the version initialization occurs in the sql server prestart, which occurs just after router setup. It became possible to hit the http routes before the version was set, leading to panics as the http routes rely on the sql version being set.

Epic: none
Fixes: #138342

issue_context.title: sql: register http routes after version initialization
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/127170 made it so that the version is set just after the http routes are registered. Using the http routes before versio initialization leads to fatal errors. We should ensure that the routes are only available after the version is initialized.

Jira issue: CRDB-46051
